literal_meaning: আধা (half) + খেঁচড়া (khichuri, a mixed rice-lentil dish)
figurative_meaning_bn: অসম্পূর্ণ; অর্ধ-সম্পাদিত; অর্ধেক একরকম অর্ধেক অন্যরকম
figurative_meaning_en: incomplete; half-finished; half one way and half another
example_sentences_in_bangla: আধাখেঁচড়া করে কাজটা ফেলে রেখো না।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't leave the work half-baked like that.
history: Originated from the concept of poorly prepared khichuri, a staple Bengali dish symbolizing mixture and incompleteness in daily rural life.
note: The idiom draws from Bengali culinary traditions where khichuri represents simplicity, but 'half-khichuri' implies haphazard preparation.
